test_title: PYST 53: SSC CGL 2024 - Reasoning (Held On 11 Sept, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
Which figure should replace the question mark (?) if the following series were to be continued?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7835cac7bf4238d3945013e8f79374f553afdcc9bfb2593eb133e2d150998e62.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is:

1) First box series:

First row corner elements interchange positions.

First two elements of third row and center element shift anticlockwise.

The rest of the elements shift anticlockwise. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/faee0722cf76e3636b82c948c9e2769aaf4d18591af18756d020967ecc1682f0.png] 

2) Second box series:

Third column elements shift to the corner opposite sides.

Second column elements shift anticlockwise.

First column elements shift to the corner opposite sides diagonally.

Top left corner element is replaced by new element.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bd88275dd6aa9306e29aaffe7788e2c66fb6a1e77766746200cea4a1bd3f5765.png] 

Thus, the final series is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8db688e6b0fe2d4f384fbf1c1297b073f262ef12a66cf1d1aa73df119784c20c.png] 

Hence. "Option 1" is the correct answer.
